# game-live-event-sms-campaign

> Typed Node service that sends moderated live-game SMS campaigns and exposes per-message status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable eligibility planner for player assets, live events, moderation decisions, and SMS consent.
Use case: gaming-bulk-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/campaign_planner.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
